question: In which of the following games is one player known as the Wicketkeeper?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The wicket-keeper in the sport of cricket is the player **on the fielding side who stands behind the wicket or stumps being watchful of the batsman and ready to take a catch, stump the batsman out and run out a batsman when occasion arises.
 
• The wicketkeeper wears **gloves** and **leg pads**, and occasionally a helmet when standing close to the stumps.
 
• **Key Responsibilities**:
 
 
• Stopping deliveries missed by the batsman to prevent runs (byes).
 
• Effecting stumpings and catches.
 
• Supporting the bowlers by encouraging or strategizing field placements.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Terminologies associated with Hockey are Bully, Sudden death, Short corner, Hat trick, Goal, Penalty Corner, Penalty, etc.
 
• Terminologies associated with Football are Goal, Kick, Head, Penalty kick, Dribble, Offside, Hat trick, Foul, Stopper, Move, Side back, Pass, Baseline, Rebound, etc.
 
• **Terminologies associated with Basketbal**l are Dribbling, Shooting, Passing, Rebounding, Block, Steal, Assist, Dunk, Three-pointer, Free throw, Layup, Alley-oop, Pivot, Buzzer-beater, Backcourt, Frontcourt, Fast break, Triple-double, Foul, Technical foul, Personal foul, Shot clock.
